build: Pre-release build of Hardcharger's feature/chargewire-rename branch (the protocol's rename to Chargewire); server, web UI and desktop frontend built from `commit`
sample_data: TPC-H SF1 (dbgen); isolated temporary database and synthetic accounts (maya, devon); no customer data
capture_command: node scripts/hardcharger-screenshots/desktop.mjs (gizmodata-website); the same capture session as the website's images
desktop_note: Desktop frontend from the same pre-release 2.3.0 commit, synthetic controller status at normal 1120x880 CSS pixels, device scale 2; no style or zoom overrides
